featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered 4 bottles of Mintop 120 ml from Red Rose Chemist. Although they were initially out of stock, they arranged it for me. However, they sent me 60 ml bottles but billed me for 120 ml bottles. When I reordered, I noticed the discrepancy and immediately informed them, providing the bill, the boxes, and proof of payment via GPay. Despite this, they refused to adjust the overcharge on my next bill.

This experience has left me feeling cheated. Be cautious and double-check your orders with them—they appear to be dishonest.

featured_reviews.review_text: Got totally ignored by the staff here. There were two people serving customers, one doing some paperwork at the counter but ignoring the customers, and another at the cash till.  I asked the guy at the cash till for help since he was otherwise not busy, and he called for someone else to help but nobody came.  I picked up a few items and put them on the counter in front of the cash guy but he steadfastly ignored me while I waited some more for him or one of the others to help but they just went ahead and started serving other people who came in after.  I know that you have to be aggressive in the busy informal shops, but this place pretends to be a premium chemist and all, but they still treat you like you're at a railway booking office in 1990.
